extensionDescription.message: Sends From, To and Subject of the active message or compose window to the local ManicTime client.

optionsIntro.message: Controls what is sent to ManicTime for the mail in the active Thunderbird window.

optionsData.message: Sent for the mail in the active window: sender, recipients, subject, account name and folder. They go only to the ManicTime client on this computer (127.0.0.1), never over the network, and are not stored by the add-on.

maxSubjectHint.message: Number of characters. Longer subjects are cut off and end with “…”. 0 means no limit.
